name: Zhuzhou Times New Material Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhuzhou Times New Material Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the development, production, testing, sales, after-sales service, and technical consulting services of polymer materials, metal materials, bridge bearings and supporting products, rubber-metal products, composite materials, and various integrated material products in China and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Industrial and Engineering, Rail Transit Construction, Wind Power Products, and Automotive Products. The Industrial and Engineering segment provides intercity railway lines, bridge bearings and wind power couplings.
